entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. It just stopped working. I only bought it a few months ago.
Okay, I understand. Let me pull up your account. Can I get your name and email address associated with the purchase?

Thanks, Jane. Okay, I see your VeloBand Pulse purchase here. It looks like it was purchased four months ago. Let me check the warranty period. One moment... Okay, so it looks like the warranty is for...90 days from purchase. So, we can definitely get that replaced for you.
Um, actually, I apologize. I just re-read the policy. It's a 30-day warranty period, not 90. My mistake.
What?! You just said 90 days! I heard you! This call is being recorded, right? Because you just promised me a replacement based on a 90-day warranty!
Ma'am, I understand your frustration, but it was a simple error on my part. The actual warranty is 30 days, and you are past that. So the warranty has expired.

This is a total bait and switch! I specifically asked about the warranty when I bought it, and I'm pretty sure they said it was longer. You're lying to me! You just told me it was 90 days! Are you saying I imagined that?
Ma'am, I'm not saying you imagined it, but I am looking at the official policy right here. It is very clearly states it's a 30-day warranty. Perhaps there was some confusion.
Confusion? You promised me! I expect you to honor what you said! I want a replacement!
I understand you're upset, but there's nothing I can do. The warranty is expired.
This is unbelievable! You're refusing to honor what you promised me on a recorded line! I want to speak to a supervisor!
Okay, one moment while I transfer you.
Hello, Jane. My name is Mark, and I'm a supervisor here at VeloFit. I understand you're having some issues with your VeloBand Pulse and the warranty?

Yes! Your agent first told me the warranty was 90 days and he promised me a replacement. Now he's trying to take it back! I think you are engaging in bait and switch, as you are not honouring what you promised me!
